title.narrative: Support for Health in Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: UNOPS support project for health aims to improve Papua New Guinea's healthcare delivery by transforming the health system's procurement and supply chain capabilities. It will provide specialized technical assistance and capacity building to the National Department of Health and Provincial Health Authorities a more efficient, transparent, and effective system for purchasing and managing medical goods and services.
